‼️ BREAKING: A 10-year-old flaw in #NGINX could let attackers execute code on servers — no login required.

Dubbed #nginx2root (CVE-2026-123007), the critical HTTP/2 vulnerability scores 9.2/10.

Public PoC available. Patches released.

Full details ↓ https://t.co/kNq60Lv5zx

Running NGINX? Check your exposure now.

→ Patch to 1.30.7 (stable) or 1.31.9 (mainline)
→ Verify HTTP/2 exposure
→ Disable HTTP/2 temporarily if patching is delayed
→ Investigate unusual worker crashes and command execution

A reload alone won't replace the vulnerable

And this isn't just theoretical.

Public PoC exploit code for CVE-2026-123007 is now on GitHub.

The published code demonstrates exploitation in a constrained local Docker test setup, not a universal exploit against every NGINX deployment. https://t.co/f13vjlrZLJ

123007 は keep_alive でゆっくり巨大なデータを送るやつで回線速度依存(1Gbpsなら最短8分)、123633は1回あたりの確率低いけど process fork が同じメモリレイアウトなので同じビルドから作られてるものは同じ exploit が使いまわせてしまう。
